name: Ruben Alvarez
title: Head of Software Development · AI-assisted delivery
profile: I lead **product development at Uniendo Nodos** with AI-assisted **Spec Driven Development (SDD)**: the AI implements and people steer the cycle — specify, design, review, validate and ship. This is not a hunch: we **measure it against our own repositories** and we budget from those numbers. And that method ships **real product to production and to the app stores**, not prototypes. I bring almost twenty years split between **hands-on development**, the **technical leadership** of two companies I co-founded and **agile coaching** — exactly the mix this moment calls for, because the bottleneck is no longer typing code but **deciding well, slicing work into shippable pieces and verifying what gets delivered**. I work with **solid practices** — TDD, DDD, continuous delivery — and I enjoy looking for **better ways to do things**; today that means steering the definition of the **harness** (rules, agents and automations) that lets the team move faster without losing control.

projects.title: OwnAutoCare
projects.shortDescription: **My own product**, from the app to the website. Vehicle maintenance history for **iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android**, published on the **App Store** and **Google Play**. Built with **Flutter** and with **no backend at all**: data lives in the user's own Google Drive, iCloud or OneDrive, with no extra accounts and no intermediate database — privacy is an architectural decision, not a promise. Service log, attached invoices, cost tracking and full history export. Built end to end with **Spec Driven Development** and **OpenSpec**. The product website —**Astro**, bilingual, a blog with scheduled publishing and continuous delivery— is mine too.

projects.title: This very résumé
projects.shortDescription: The page you are reading. **Astro** and **Tailwind**, bilingual with an automated check that both dictionaries stay in sync, light and dark themes with browser detection, and a print stylesheet so it downloads as a PDF. End-to-end tests on **Chromium and WebKit** plus visual regression snapshots, and a **Lighthouse audit that fails the build if any category drops below 100**. Continuous delivery to **Netlify** straight from the workflow.

projects.title: Movi-info
projects.shortDescription: Movie information management, used as an architecture testbed. **React 19** with **TypeScript** and **Vite** on the frontend and **.NET 10** on the backend, both with **hexagonal architecture** and the **DDD, Repository, Criteria** patterns plus a **query bus (CQRS)** on MediatR. Tests at four levels: unit, infrastructure against the live API, acceptance with **Gherkin** and accessibility with **jest-axe**. Continuous delivery via **GitHub Actions** to **Netlify** and **Render**, served from a single origin through a reverse proxy.

experience.title: Head of Software Development
responsibilities: I lead the company's product development — **architect and lead developer**, with a team — mainly within the **Smartsheet** ecosystem, where Uniendo Nodos is a **partner**.

Development cycle under **Spec Driven Development (SDD)** with **OpenSpec** and **Claude Code**: every change goes through *explore → propose → apply → verify → publish*, with **human review of each artefact before a line of code is written**. The AI implements; the team steers, reviews and decides.

**Klonup**: a **backup SaaS for Smartsheet** in commercial operation. **TypeScript** monorepo on **Node** with **DDD and hexagonal architecture** — 7 *bounded contexts* and over 100 use cases — persistence on **Firestore** and **PostgreSQL**, subscriptions with a payment gateway and tax invoicing.

Designed the **multi-phase execution engine** behind the backups —asynchronous dispatch with **Google Cloud Tasks**, in-house *rate limiting* against the Smartsheet API and cleanup phases with **partial and full rollback**— and the **CI/CD on Google Cloud Build** that ships it: parallelised pipelines, tests as a gate, automated migrations to **Cloud Run** and semantic versioning from *Conventional Commits*.

I sustain a measurable quality culture: **over 6,500 tests** (Jest, Vitest, Playwright) under **mandatory TDD**, **22 blocking architecture rules** and **141 ADRs** the team consults before implementing.

**162 changes specified, tested and deployed in a single quarter, with 18% corrective work**, by a two-person team — including a junior developer in their first job, whom I train and supervise. I budget from those same measured figures instead of guessing.

Architect and lead developer of a **multi-tenant SaaS platform** (**Next.js**, **React**, **Supabase**, **Inngest**): per-organisation isolation with **Row Level Security** on PostgreSQL, **passwordless access via Magic Link**, multi-currency plans with *entitlements* and per-role limits, and a full free-trial lifecycle with reminders and grace-period deactivation.

Steered the definition of the **AI-assisted engineering harness** the organisation runs on —rules that auto-load based on the file being touched, *skills*, sub-agents and workflow commands versioned in the repository and shared across tools— and designed a **delivery control plane** that dispatches headless agents in an **ephemeral sandbox**, stack-agnostic, with a **dedicated GitHub App, service account impersonation and managed secrets**: zero long-lived credentials.
